tasks_completed.description: Made terminal fixture and renderer cover command, stdout, stderr, nonzero exit/status, and command-once detail semantics.
tasks_completed.rationale: Codex feedback identified array-command duplicate descriptions; ToolFullView now normalizes command strings, shell wrappers, command arrays, and parsed_cmd before suppressing echoed descriptions.

tasks_completed.description: Fixed patch/detail rendering to show parsed unified diff content before any generic raw JSON surface.
tasks_completed.rationale: Patch acceptance requires complete old/new diff rendering; CodexPatch detail/sidebar now parse unified_diff and specialized full views own their payload instead of leading with raw input/output JSON.

tasks_completed.description: Provided markdown/rich detail proof through the real message detail renderer.
tasks_completed.rationale: Agent/user text detail now uses MarkdownView, so rich markdown detail uses the same parser as the inline message surface.

tasks_completed.description: Added view-image fixture rendering with image preview and attachment metadata.
tasks_completed.rationale: Binary attachment evidence alone did not satisfy image/view-image acceptance; functions.view_image now has a reachable sample with previewUri, path, dimensions, and size.

tasks_completed.description: Added MCP resource rendering reachability and resource-specific title/subtitle behavior.
tasks_completed.rationale: MCP permission rows were insufficient; mcp__resources__read now exposes resources.read, file://fixture.md, and result content through inline/detail/sidebar renderers.

tasks_completed.description: Removed expectation-chip contamination and split manifest expectations by surface.
tasks_completed.rationale: Codex feedback noted that visible expected-string chips could falsely satisfy QA text searches; the UI no longer renders those oracle strings outside the real renderer surfaces.

qa_blockers_addressed.blocker: Patch/detail appears as raw diff JSON rather than complete diff rendering.
qa_blockers_addressed.resolution: CodexPatch detail/sidebar parse unified_diff into ToolDiffView and ToolFullView suppresses generic Input/Output/Error sections for specialized payload-owning tools.

qa_blockers_addressed.blocker: Markdown/rich content lacks separate detail-surface proof.
qa_blockers_addressed.resolution: Added markdown-rich-detail fixture and changed text message detail to render MarkdownView instead of plain Text.

qa_blockers_addressed.blocker: Binary attachment evidence does not satisfy image/view-image acceptance.
qa_blockers_addressed.resolution: Added functions.view_image fixture with plot.png path, data-URI preview, 640×480 metadata, and CodexAttachmentView image preview rendering.

qa_blockers_addressed.blocker: MCP-adjacent permission evidence does not satisfy resource rendering acceptance.
qa_blockers_addressed.resolution: Added mcp__resources__read fixture plus known tool title/subtitle/status and generic/sidebar output handling for resource URI and content.

codex_consult.feedback_summary: Codex flagged five concrete issues: terminal duplicate-command suppression missed command arrays, visible expectation chips contaminated evidence, patch expectations needed surface-specific strings, MCP resource inline could miss URI/title, and generic full detail dropped falsey outputs.
codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: Implemented command-array/shell-wrapper/parsed_cmd duplicate suppression, removed expectation chips from the UI, split manifest expectations by inline/detail/sidebar, made known MCP resource titles/subtitles reachable in ToolView, included URI in the resource fixture result, and changed ToolFullView to render own-property falsey results.

recommendations: QA should capture post-deploy desktop and mobile evidence for every fixture id listed in iter2-ui-fixture-targets.json.
If QA validates the fixture route, keep it dev-only and do not use it as production-session evidence.
Consider a follow-up cleanup after closure to separate pre-existing dirty Codex protocol changes from this renderer evidence iteration.
